_notes: Hand-curated backcountry lines for the Presidential Range (MWAC forecast zone).
Geometry comes from OpenStreetMap ways (ODbL, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors); build_backcountry.py fetches it
and derives elevation, slope angle and aspect from USGS 3DEP. Re-run it after editing this list.
Deliberately excluded: The Icefall (ice-fall hazard zone, not a ski line) and the Chute N/S variations (duplicates).
These are expert, avalanche-prone lines. Listing one here is not a recommendation to ski it.

zone.name: Presidential Range
zone._points: Snow/temperature are sampled at each area's point; ridge-top wind (what loads the ravines) at wind_point.

area_hazards.Tuckerman Ravine: Avalanche terrain throughout. Long sliding falls on firm snow. In spring: falling ice, crevasses and undermined snow, especially below the Headwall (Lip, Sluice, Center).
area_hazards.Gulf of Slides: Avalanche terrain. Less traffic than Tuckerman, so a rescue can take longer.
area_hazards.Pinkham ski trails: Narrow, often icy trails with rocks and water bars; crowded with descending skiers on spring weekends. The trails start below the ravines but the routes into them cross avalanche runout zones.
